name: Markus Luis Flores
title: Software Developer
tagline: Software Developer with more than 5 years on large-scale SaaS applications, comfortable anywhere from the frontend to the database and quick to pick up new technologies, most recently AI. Writes clean, efficient code and designs software around what the business and its users actually need.

bullets.text: Design and develop test automation and technical solutions for Charles River Development (CRD), RBC's trading platform in Wealth Management Technology.
Build and maintain automated regression suites using Playwright and RBC's internal testing frameworks.
Design end-to-end and integration test cases with model-based design tools (ConformIQ, Hexawise), and drive AI-assisted test generation from Jira requirements using GitHub Copilot.
Deploy and validate QA environments on Red Hat OpenShift through GitHub Actions and UrbanCode Deploy pipelines, monitoring pod health and logs after each rollout.
Collaborate in Agile ceremonies to align technical work with sprint deliverables.
Manage test execution and defect triage in Jira and qTest, documenting results and reporting status to stakeholders.
Designed and developed new features and enhancements for Infor's SaaS Human Capital Management (HCM) platform based on business requirements.
Maintained and improved existing HCM modules using Agile and object-oriented programming (OOP) practices.
Led code reviews through meetings, Crucible, and GitLab. Maintained release version code using AccuRev and Git.
Authored functional and technical design documents, user documentation, and client knowledge transfer (KT) materials.
Collaborated with Business Analysts and Product Owners to influence design decisions and deliver customer solutions.
Supported QA teams by preparing detailed test cases, contributing to automation scripts, and ensuring coverage for functional and regression testing.

projects.title: The Fourth Official
projects.subtitle: Personal Project
projects.builtWith: Next.js, Supabase Postgres + pgvector, Voyage embeddings, Claude Haiku 4.5, Vitest, Railway

bullets.text: Built a hybrid retrieval pipeline over the IFAB Laws of the Game, fusing pgvector similarity search and Postgres full-text search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion in a single SQL query.

Generated grounded answers with Claude using native citations, streaming claim-to-passage links alongside a panel showing every retrieved passage, its similarity score, and whether the answer used it.
Tuned retrieval against measured evals (recall@8, MRR) and calibrated a relevance gate that abstains on off-topic questions before any generation spend.
Built solo using Claude Code as the primary development tool, running a structured spec, plan, implementation, and review workflow backed by design docs and ADRs.
Designed and developed core application features and workflows based on team requirements, from UI components to business logic.
Set up Playwright test automation from scratch and wrote the initial test suite covering core CRUD flows.
Contributed to CI/CD and code-quality tooling.
Built a mobile carpool booking application with Infor's Community of Business Analysts, as part of a 5-person team.
Won Infor's Innovation Flight Central Shark Tank competition and Habi Team of the Year at Infor's Sinagtala Awards.
